about: The Iai's chiburi and resheathe after its horizontal draw (KE task 18), Elden Ring's: from the draw's held extension (iai_draw_horizontal frame 31, blended in over 14 frames, so the arm stays out) the blade flicked down and out to the right (the chiburi, a turn of the forearm on frames 1-10), then put back into the saya at the left hip by SheatheHips01_R (from frame 12, in by frame 21), the stance's crouch taken again; iai_resheathe_horizontal_to_guard then draws it into the guard. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
